sql: SELECT firstName, lastName, deathYear - birthYear FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND deathYear IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.lgID IN ('PCHA','NHL') GROUP BY T2.playerID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.lgID) > 1
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL)/COUNT(T2.playerID) FROM Goalies T2 JOIN Master T1 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID GROUP BY T2.playerID ORDER BY COUNT(T2.playerID) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstName, T1.lastName, T3.name FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID JOIN Teams T3 ON T2.tmID=T3.tmID AND T2.year=T3.year WHERE T1.birthCountry='Canada' AND T1.deathYear IS NOT NULL AND T1.pos='G'

SELECT T2.nameGiven, T3.name, T3.year FROM Coaches T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T2.coachID=T1.coachID JOIN Teams T3 ON T1.year=T3.year AND T1.tmID=T3.tmID WHERE T2.playerID IS NOT NULL AND T2.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.nameGiven, CAST(SUM(T2.Min) AS REAL)/SUM(T2.GP) FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T1.playerID='aebisda01' GROUP BY T1.nameGiven
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.coachID) FROM Coaches T1 JOIN Master T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID WHERE T1.w>30 AND T2.birthCountry='USA'
SELECT firstName FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND hofID IS NOT NULL
SELECT W FROM Goalies WHERE playerID='vanbijo01' AND year=1990
SELECT T1.w FROM Coaches T1 JOIN AwardsCoaches T2 ON T1.coachID=T2.coachID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T2.year=1933 AND T2.award='Second Team All-Star'
SELECT T1.firstName, T1.lastName FROM Master T1 JOIN Goalies T2 ON T1.playerID=T2.playerID WHERE T2.year=2002 AND T2.GA>150 ORDER BY T1.birthYear DESC, T1.birthMon DESC, T1.birthDay DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T2.name FROM Goalies T1 JOIN Teams T2 ON T1.tmID=T2.tmID AND T1.year=T2.year WHERE T1.year=2010 GROUP BY T2.tmID HAVING SUM(T1.PostENG) = (SELECT MAX(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(PostENG) s FROM Goalies WHERE year=2010 GROUP BY tmID))
SELECT GP FROM ScoringSC WHERE playerID='broadpu01' AND year=1922
SELECT BenchMinor, name FROM Teams ORDER BY T DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(playerID) FROM Master WHERE shootCatch IS NULL AND firstNHL='2011'
